textes.Bienvenue au club Pulsar, une salle de s: Welcome to the Pulsar club, a neighborhood gym. Members, coaches, group classes, subscriptions and bookings: all the club’s data is here. You help its team: Inès at the front desk, Bastien on the class schedule, Yanis on loyalty and Mathilde, the director. Explore the database to solve the missions.

textes.Une ligne par contrat d’abonnement : sa: One row per subscription contract: its plan, its price and its dates. A member can have several in a row, or none; an empty end date (NULL) means an active subscription.

textes.Une ligne par inscription d’un adhérent: One row per member booking for a slot on the schedule, with its date and whether they actually came. A member books the same slot at most once.

textes.Quels adhérents n’ont aucun abonnement e: Which members have no active subscription?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each member of the club can take out a subscription (monthly, annual or at the student rate), and take several in a row. When a subscription stops, its end date is recorded; until it is, the subscription is active. Inès, at the front desk, is launching a re-subscription campaign. She wants to call every member who has no active subscription, including those who never took one.
textes.les adhérents qui n’ont aucun abonnement: the members who have no active subscription (empty end date)
textes.y compris ceux qui n’ont jamais eu d’abo: including those who never had a subscription
textes.Un adhérent qui a un contrat terminé et: A member with one finished contract and another active one does have an active subscription.
textes.Pour chaque adhérent, demande-toi s’il e: For each member, ask whether there’s a subscription of theirs whose end date is empty. Keep only those for whom the answer is no: that way, members without any contract stay in the list.
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each coach has their specialty: yoga, pilates, zumba, CrossFit, cardio or weight training. Bastien, who sets the group class slots and assigns them to coaches, is preparing a directory to post in the lobby, discipline by discipline. He starts with the yoga page: he wants the coaches who specialize in yoga, with their hire date to show their seniority.
textes.Une seule condition sur la spécialité, c: A single condition on the specialty, compared exactly with the text “Yoga”, with its capital letter.
textes.Quels cours peuvent accueillir plus de 1: Which classes can take more than 15 people?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class has its weekly slots, a duration, a level and a number of spots per slot. A nearby company wants to book a group of employees. Inès, at the front desk, is looking for the classes that offer more than 15 spots per slot, with their duration and level, to offer the company the ones that suit.
textes.la durée d’une séance, en minutes: the length of a session, in minutes
textes.les cours dont la capacité maximale dépa: the classes whose maximum capacity is above 15 spots (15 not included)
textes.par capacité maximale, de la plus grande: by maximum capacity, largest first, then by class name
textes.Une seule condition sur le nombre de pla: A single condition on the number of spots: more than 15, so 15 doesn’t count. Then sort from the largest number of spots to the smallest, then by name.
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class is assigned to a coach, but some coaches don’t teach any. Mathilde, the director, wants to launch a new class in the fall. Before hiring, she’s looking among her coaches for those who don’t have a class assigned yet, with their specialty, to know what they could teach.

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each member gives their date of birth and email address when joining the club. Inès, at the front desk, is launching an offer just for the youngest, those born after January 1, 2000: a free month of group classes. Before finding them a place in the week, he reviews the rooms meant for group classes and the area of each one.

Each group class has its weekly slots, and members book them at the front desk; a booking counts even if the member didn’t end up coming. Inès, who runs the front desk, wants to email the week’s schedule to the members who haven’t booked any slot yet, to make them want to try.

Each member pays for a subscription, monthly, annual or at the student rate; it stays active as long as no end date is recorded. Inès, at the front desk, is checking who’s covered right now. For each active subscription, she wants to see its holder, its plan and the price paid.

Inès, at the front desk, is preparing for him the list of Advanced level classes, with the length of a session and the number of spots per slot, so he can pick his.

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class has its weekly slots, and members book the ones that suit them. Bastien, who sets the slots, wants to fill the Monday ones more. He wants to invite every member who has never booked a Monday slot, even those who aren’t booked for any class; one Monday booking is enough to leave someone out, even if absent.

textes.Pour chaque adhérent, demande-toi s’il e: For each member, ask whether there’s a booking of theirs on a Monday slot; the day is stored with the schedule. Keep only those for whom the answer is no.
textes.Combien d’inscriptions compte chaque cou: How many bookings does each class have?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class has one or more weekly slots, and members book these slots. Bastien, who sets the schedule, wonders which classes deserve one more slot. He compares the number of bookings of each class, all slots combined and whether or not the member came, without forgetting the classes that don’t have any yet.
textes.le nom du cours (une ligne par cours): the class name (one row per class)

textes.tous les cours, y compris ceux qui n’ont: every class, including those with no slot or no booking

by number of bookings, largest first, then by last name, then by first name

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Its members subscribe monthly, annually or at the student rate, and each subscription signed has its price; a member can sign several. Mathilde, the director, is going to review her prices. Before deciding, she wants to compare what each plan has brought the club since the start: the number of subscriptions signed and the revenue they represent.
textes.la formule de l’abonnement (une ligne pa: the subscription plan (one row per plan)

textes.Quels adhérents se sont inscrits à plus: Which members booked more than 2 slots?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Its members book group class slots: yoga, pilates, zumba, CrossFit… The same class can have several weekly slots, and a booking counts even if absent. Yanis, in charge of loyalty, rewards the most regular. This month, he’s offering a session with a coach to those booked for more than 2 different slots on the schedule.
textes.les adhérents inscrits à plus de 2 créne: the members booked for more than 2 different slots (at least 3)
textes.par nombre de créneaux, du plus grand au: by number of slots, largest first, then by last name, then by first name

textes.Toutes les inscriptions comptent, même e: Every booking counts, even if absent.

textes.Quel est le taux de présence de chaque c: What is each class’s attendance rate?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. You book a group class slot, then you come… or not: the coach records the attendance of each person booked, 1 if they came, 0 otherwise. Bastien, who sets the class schedule, wants to know, class by class, what share of the people booked actually come to the sessions, to spot the classes losing their audience.

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class is assigned to a coach, and some coaches teach several. Mathilde, the director, is sharing out the new fall classes. textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class accepts a number of spots per slot, and some slots are fully booked: members leave the front desk disappointed. Each slot counts separately, even if it belongs to the same class as another. Bastien, who sets the class schedule, wants to spot the slots where bookings reach the number of spots, to know where to open more next season.

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Inès runs the front desk there: the counter at the entrance, where she welcomes members and sells subscriptions, monthly, annual or at the student rate. A subscription stays active as long as no end date is recorded, and a member may have had several. On Monday, at the team meeting, she has to present how many members are currently subscribed to each of the club’s three plans: Annual, Monthly and Student.
textes.le nombre d’adhérents différents qui ont: the number of different members who have an active subscription on this plan

He first wants to invite the members who have already come at least once to one of the club’s yoga classes; a booking followed by an absence doesn’t count.

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each group class slot has its bookings, and the coach records who came. Bastien, who sets the class schedule, wants to congratulate the most faithful groups. He’s looking for the slots where no one booked missed the session, including those with no bookings, to post their class, day and time in the lobby.

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. She’s archiving the subscriptions that have run out and wants the list of all those that have expired, even if the member subscribed again since, with their holder and their end date.

textes.Quels sont les 3 coachs les plus demandé: Which are the 3 most popular coaches?

For the club’s annual party, Mathilde, the director, wants to honor the 3 coaches whose classes draw the most bookings, all classes and slots combined, whether or not the member came. They’ll get a trophy in front of the members.
textes.son nombre total d’inscriptions, tous co: their total number of bookings, all classes and slots combined

textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each subscription starts on a date and brings the club its price, whether it has finished since or is still active. Mathilde, the director, keeps a close eye on these new contracts. For her meeting with the bank, she wants to see, month after month, what the contracts starting bring in, and whether that revenue goes up or down compared with the month before.
textes.le mois de début des contrats, au format: the contracts’ start month, in YYYY-MM format, for example “2024-01” (one row per month)

textes.Qui s’inscrit à plus de créneaux que la: Who books more slots than average?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Its members book group class slots, more or less often. Yanis, in charge of loyalty, wants to reward the most committed. He’s looking for those booked for more different slots than the average member, calculated over those with at least one booking, and by how much they beat it.

textes.Toutes les inscriptions comptent, même e: Every booking counts, even if absent; two slots of the same class count as two.

textes.Comment se classent les cours selon leur: How do the classes rank by attendance rate?

A class’s attendance rate is the share of its bookings who actually come, all slots combined. Bastien, who sets the class schedule, wants to understand what makes members come. He ranks the classes by this rate, from the most to the least attended.
textes.son taux de présence en pourcentage, sur: its attendance rate as a percentage out of 100, rounded to one decimal place: attendances × 100 ÷ bookings, all of the class’s slots combined

textes.Un coach qui n’anime qu’un cours compte: A coach who teaches only one class counts as soon as the member attended it.
textes.Garde les présences et forme un groupe p: Keep the attendances and make one group for each member and coach pair. Count the different classes taken, and compare that number with the number of all the coach’s classes, calculated separately.
textes.Quels cours font mieux que la moyenne de: Which classes do better than their coach’s average?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. The same coach sometimes teaches several group classes, and some draw more bookings than others. Bastien, who sets the schedule, wants to know which ones work best. He compares each class’s bookings, whether or not the member came, with the average of the same coach’s classes, a class without bookings counting as 0.
textes.la moyenne du coach : son nombre moyen d: the coach’s average: their average number of bookings per class, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les cours dont le nombre d’inscriptions: the classes whose number of bookings is strictly above their coach’s average
textes.par coach, dans l’ordre alphabétique du: by coach, in alphabetical order of the text shown (first name first)
textes.Tous les cours du coach comptent dans sa: All the coach’s classes count in their average, even a class without bookings (0).
textes.Procède en deux temps : compte d’abord l: Work in two steps: first count each class’s bookings, keeping the classes without bookings, then calculate the average per coach. Finally, compare each class with its coach’s average.
textes.Comment se classent les coachs selon leu: How do the coaches rank by bookings?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Each coach teaches group classes, whose slots draw more or fewer bookings. Mathilde, the director, is preparing the year-end reviews with her coaches. She wants to rank all the coaches by the number of bookings for their classes, whether or not people came, including those who aren’t teaching any class right now.
textes.son nombre total d’inscriptions, tous co: their total number of bookings, all classes and slots combined, 0 if they have none
textes.son rang : 1 pour le plus grand nombre d: their rank: 1 for the largest number of bookings, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.Pars de tous les coachs et descends jusq: Start from every coach and go down to the bookings through the classes and slots, keeping those with nothing at the end. Count the bookings found, then rank: ties share their rank.
textes.Quels adhérents sont venus dans plusieur: Which members have come to several rooms?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. Its group classes take place in six rooms, from the weights room to the yoga studio; each slot takes place in one of them. Bastien, who sets the class schedule, wants to know which members move from one room to another over their sessions, to spread the equipment better. He’s looking for those who were present in at least 2 different rooms.
textes.le nombre de salles différentes où il a: the number of different rooms where they were present
textes.les adhérents présents dans au moins 2 s: the members present in at least 2 different rooms
textes.par nombre de salles, du plus grand au p: by number of rooms, largest first, then by last name
textes.Seules les présences comptent : une insc: Only attendances count: a booking followed by an absence doesn’t count.
textes.La salle d’une séance est celle de son c: A session’s room is the one of its slot.
textes.Garde les présences et relie-les à leur: Keep the attendances and link them to their slot, which gives the room. Count each member’s different rooms, then keep those who have at least 2.
textes.Qui a payé plus que la moyenne de sa for: Who paid more than their plan’s average?
textes.Le club Pulsar est une salle de sport de: The Pulsar club is a neighborhood gym. A member can take several subscriptions in a row, each with its plan and its price, finished or active. Mathilde, the director, wants to thank the most loyal members. Plan by plan, she compares what each member spent on subscriptions of that plan with the average of the members who took it out.
textes.la formule de l’abonnement (une ligne pa: the subscription plan (one row per member and per plan)
textes.son total : la somme des prix de ses con: their total: the sum of the prices of their contracts on this plan, in euros
textes.la moyenne des totaux de cette formule,: the average of this plan’s totals, rounded to two decimal places
textes.les adhérents dont le total dépasse stri: the members whose total is strictly above their plan’s average
textes.par formule, puis par total, du plus éle: by plan, then by total, highest first
textes.Les contrats terminés comptent autant qu: Finished contracts count as much as active ones.
textes.La moyenne d’une formule porte seulement: A plan’s average only covers the members who took it out.
textes.Procède en deux temps : calcule d’abord: Work in two steps: first calculate each member’s total for each plan, then the average of these totals per plan. Finally, compare each member with their plan’s average.
